analysis_plan.interaction: (direct - visible) at row 10 minus (direct - visible) at row 1
analysis_plan.secondary: All ten row accuracies and harms; H2-H1; H10-H9; (H5+H6)/2-(H1+H10)/2; direct/visible endpoint shifts; pattern choices and record sensitivity. Curve intervals are pointwise and unadjusted, not a search for the best contrast.
analysis_plan.unit: One fresh world, averaging both recorded-label variants before pairing positions and arms.
analysis_plan.primary_complete_world: Only the eight endpoint responses must be valid; missing nonendpoint responses do not discard a primary world.
analysis_plan.intervals: 95% percentile intervals from whole-world resampling. Pointwise secondary intervals are unadjusted. Degenerate intervals cannot establish precision.
analysis_plan.sign_test: Exact two-sided sign balance test on nonzero world contrasts, with ties reported; not a test of the mean magnitude or a decision gate.
analysis_plan.bounds: All 24 planned worlds; missing/invalid accuracy ranges 0..1 and sensitivity -1..1, retaining all coefficient signs. Bounds are not confidence intervals.
analysis_plan.evidence: 24 fresh deterministic draws from the same generator family. No previous responses or outcome selection; original development worlds are excluded. This tests new-world generalization, not new task families or models.
analysis_plan.hypothesis: Moving the target from row 1 to row 10 increases direct-minus-visible accuracy harm by at least 0.20.
analysis_plan.trace_review: Offline manual review of every returned visible response, including invalid responses, with exact quoted evidence. False missingness, within-trace contradictions, and gold-then-override are separate nullable codes; never decision gates.

decision_rule.purpose: Fresh-world confirmation within the same generator family; not a mechanism or broad generality claim.
decision_rule.collection: All 960 planned responses must return; no outcome-selected extension or stopping.
decision_rule.confirmation: Positive first/last interaction >= 0.20, 95% interval lower endpoint > 0, and full-plan lower bound >= 0.20. Label confirm_positive_interaction.
decision_rule.reverse: Interaction <= -0.20, interval upper endpoint < 0, and full-plan upper bound <= -0.20. Label reverse_effect; this does not confirm the directional prediction.
decision_rule.deprioritize: Nondegenerate interval and full-plan bounds strictly inside (-0.20,0.20): smaller_than_target, not equivalence or proof of no position effect.
decision_rule.otherwise: Inconclusive; degenerate bootstrap intervals cannot calibrate precision, including when a large observed effect meets the directional rule.
decision_rule.adherence: Every position/arm: at least 95% of all 48 planned responses must have answer-only output for direct or pre-answer text for visible. Cosmetic terminal formatting is separate.
